rule_outs: Dwelling 5 m from the best section
summary: Very steep short kerb with houses 7-15m away on the same side.

drivers.seclusion: Houses and townhouses front the north kerb: 7m at 17-19m, 9m at 27m, 14-15m near the start; closer ones further along.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street, a few cars parked along the road, but the grade is severe.
drivers.convention: A few cars park here but it is a dense residential strip with no overnight convention; no signs.

sun_shade: Mostly open; townhouses on the north side shade the kerb from the north and east in the morning.

best_section.where: Prospect Terrace north kerb at the eastern end, opposite the corner lots
